summary.value_for_baseline_comparison: These two samples expose the **boundary** of the current pipeline: a Java-only static analyzer cannot recover MASVS-CRYPTO findings hidden in .so files. They serve as honest negative results in the baseline corpus and as reference cases for the limitations section in PPT/report.
